business_problem: OUTFRONT Media needed a more robust data platform to load and analyze large third-party media-spend and transactional datasets faster so its sales teams could advise advertisers with current cross-channel performance insights instead of waiting weeks for reports.
solution_summary: OUTFRONT Media moved its advertising analytics workloads onto Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Analytics so it could merge third-party spend data with transactional sales information at cloud scale. Oracle Autonomous Database provides the secure, automated data layer, removing manual tuning, patching, and security work that previously consumed engineering time. Oracle Analytics publishes interactive dashboards from the unified data so the salesforce can show customers how outdoor advertising performs relative to online, TV, radio, and print. Instead of waiting weeks for batch loading and report preparation, the company now loads terabytes of source data in minutes and serves dashboards directly from the Oracle environment. The pay-for-capacity cloud model also lowers cost relative to previous on-premises and subscription database options while giving the analytics team more time to focus on data modeling and customer insight generation.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous Database
solution_components.role: Stores and processes third-party media spend and transactional sales data with automated tuning, patching, and security.

solution_components.name: Oracle Analytics
solution_components.role: Publishes interactive dashboards that let the salesforce compare cross-channel ad performance for customers.

data_flow: Third-party media spend and transactional sales data is loaded into Oracle Autonomous Database, merged into a unified advertising-performance dataset, and then surfaced through Oracle Analytics dashboards used by the salesforce to advise customers on spend allocation across outdoor and other media channels.
integration_points: online, TV, radio, and print channel reporting
business_outcome: OUTFRONT Media compressed data loading from two to three weeks to minutes, reduced administrative database effort, lowered platform cost, and equipped sales teams with timely dashboards that improve how they guide customer advertising investments.
